_comment: Speaker personas of the voiced line pool (VoiceLines.json pja/pen), one per language: a persona is one voice actor, found by clustering the ja and en recordings (voice-research persona build). gender and band (male young/mature/elderly, female young/adult/elderly) choose which enemies may be given it; assignable = big enough to voice a whole fight (>= 8 lines, >= 5 events); fallback = assignable personas of the same gender to borrow an event from, same band first, most similar voice first. character is for display only (and for leaving out named story characters). kind = boss: built from the fx (processed boss/primal) lines, grouped by speaker cluster per language with clusters under 8 lines merged into the most similar one of the same gender; given to monsters and demihumans regardless of gender, never to humans; fallback = the other boss personas, same gender first, most similar first.
